sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 231 was established by Ordinance No. 19092, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 19, 1986. Ordinance No. 19092 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 231 is established on property generally located along the northwest line of Fair Oaks Avenue southwest of the southwest line of Walnut Hill Lane. The size of PD 231 is approximately 1.3112 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a day care center or private school, utilization of the Property must comply with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 231A).

(b) If no day care center or private school is developed, no development plan is necessary for development of the Property for single-family uses. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Rendering
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.105. RENDERING.

For a day care center or private school, development must generally conform to the rendering labelled Exhibit 231B. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711; 26457)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.106. PERMITTED USES.

(a) If a day care center or private school is developed, the only permitted uses on the Property are a day care center and a private school.

(b) If a day care center or private school is not developed, the only permitted use on the Property is single-family. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Development Standards For Uses If No Day Care
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.107. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS FOR USES IF NO DAY CARE CENTER OR PRIVATE SCHOOL IS DEVELOPED.

If no day care center or private school is developed, development of the Property must fully comply with all requirements of single-family development set forth in the Dallas Development Code for a TH-1 Townhouse District. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.108. FLOOR AREA.

For a day care center or private school, maximum permitted floor area for all uses on the Property combined is 8,228 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.109. HEIGHT.

For a day care center or private school, maximum permitted height for all structures is 24 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.110. LANDSCAPING.

For a day care center or private school, landscaping must be provided as shown on the city plan commission-approved landscaped plan (Exhibit 231C). All landscaping must be installed prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a day care center and must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711; 26457)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.111. PARKING.

For a day care center or private school, off-street parking must be provided at the ratio of one space for each 500 square feet of floor area and located as shown on the approved development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Ingress-Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.112. INGRESS-EGRESS.

For a day care center or private school, a circular drive or similar area must be provided for the off-street loading and unloading of children as shown on the approved development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Indoor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.113. INDOOR AREA.

For a day care center or private school, a minimum of 50 square feet of indoor area must be provided for each child in attendance. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Outdoor Play Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.114. OUTDOOR PLAY AREA.

For a day care center or private school, a minimum of 100 square feet of outdoor play space must be provided for each child in the play area at one time. The outdoor play area must be located as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.115. FENCING.

For a day care center or private school, the outdoor play area must be totally enclosed with a minimum four-foot-high fence as shown on the development plan. In addition, a six-foot solid screening wall must be constructed along the southeastern boundary line of the Property currently adjacent to the R- 7.5 Single-Family District. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.116. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-231.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 231 is located on Zoning Map No. F-8. (Ord. Nos. 19092; 25711)
